title: rosa carolina f. triloba
intro: Rosa carolina f. triloba, commonly known as the American rose, is a flowering plant species native to eastern North America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and sore throats, thanks to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa carolina f. triloba include acting as an antipyretic, antirheumatic, and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
